description: List your workspace's payments, newest first: each one's id, invoice, customer, amount, currency, status and method. Pass customer_id for one customer, or status for pending, completed or refunded payments. Needs a Last Price credential with billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

customer_id.description: Only this customer's rows: the customer UUID.

limit.description: How many rows to return. Defaults to 100.

offset.description: How many rows to skip, for the next page. Defaults to 0.

name: list_payments
